svg.desc: TLS WebSocket inbound messages/s. Orange: Scrapanium Bend; purple: matched curl_cffi Python. Bars are medians; whiskers span every run. go peer, 30 bytes, 1 frames per server write: 559,248 versus 375,532; go peer, 1024 bytes, 1 frames per server write: 458,063 versus 308,289; go peer, 65536 bytes, 1 frames per server write: 38,374 versus 31,946; go peer, 30 bytes, 64 frames per server write: 1,632,808 versus 693,963; go peer, 1024 bytes, 64 frames per server write: 973,789 versus 462,635; go peer, 65536 bytes, 64 frames per server write: 39,219 versus 32,018. 7 shuffled repeats. Both clients check every byte and opcode inside timing. Verified loopback TLS, matched backend, Chrome 146. Multiple connections use independent client processes. Startup, upgrade, warmup and close excluded. Source: benchmarks/results/websocket-streaming.json.
